name: io.github.partprogramming09/metal-gpu-trace
title: GPU Trace (Universal Windows & Apple Silicon)
description: Measure Windows Direct3D (D3D11/D3D12), bgfx workloads, and Wine/macOS programs' GPU use

environmentVariables.name: METAL_TRACE_OUT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the directory where recordings go

environmentVariables.name: METAL_TRACE_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Directory where downloaded workloads and benchmarks are cached

environmentVariables.name: METAL_TRACE_WINE
environmentVariables.description: Wine directory holding bin/wine, used when a recording names none
